subject: Rebaseline: POC scope and success criteria for AcmeCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: POC success criteria and next steps

Alex - great call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the POC next week:

1) Agreed success criteria (draft):
   - Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 900ms for 2k token prompt typical traffic profile
   - Accuracy: >= 85% on the provided evaluation set (intent + slot extraction)
   - Cost: token cost <= $0.003/token equivalent at expected QPS
   - Reliability: no more than 1% error rate over a 24-hour run

2) Scope: primary use case = customer support triage (classification + suggested replies).
   - Optional secondary use case: intent extraction for routing (we discussed but held to stretch goals).

3) Timeline:
   - Kickoff (environment + test data sharing): Jun 15
   - Baseline run (1 week): Jun 22-Jun 28
   - Eval and rebaseline: Jun 29-Jul 2

4) Owners:
   - Acme: Alex (engineering lead), Priya (PM/eval lead)
   - Redwood: Marissa (sales/POC owner), Camila (solutions eng), David (security & infra touchpoint)

5) Next steps (action items):
   - Acme to share anonymized eval set and sample traffic (by Jun 14)
   - Redwood to provide POC plan + metrics template (attached)
   - Schedule 30-min kickoff (Camila to lead demo & infra checklist)

Attachments: acme_poc_proposal_v2.pdf (POC plan), metrics_template.xlsx

If this matches your understanding, confirm and we'll lock dates.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmecorp.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC success criteria and next steps

Thanks Marissa - that looks good and aligns with our notes. A couple of updates from our side after internal sync:

- We can deliver a sanitized eval set by Jun 14, working with Priya.
- Change in scope request: leadership wants us to validate one additional high-value use case during the POC - an automated fraud-flagging assistant that analyzes user messages for policy violations. It's higher priority if we can fit it in.
- If we add fraud detection, we'll need a simple precision/recall goal (suggested: precision >= 90% at recall >= 70%).

Question: would adding this use case change the timeline or require extra infra on your side? Also, what would the evaluation plan look like for a small labeled fraud sample?

Appreciate you rebaselining - happy to discuss on the kickoff if needed.

-Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC success criteria and next steps

Alex - thanks for the heads up. That use case makes sense and is something we can accommodate, but it does require re-baselining a few items:

- Scope update: add "fraud-flagging assistant" as a secondary use case to be evaluated during the baseline run.
- Success criteria (added): precision >= 90% / recall >= 70% on the provided fraud sample. We'll measure on the same timeframe as baseline run.
- Data: we'll need at least 250 labeled fraud vs. non-fraud samples for a meaningful evaluation; if you can't provide that many, we can do a smaller pilot but results will be noisy.
- Infra: no additional infra required from Acme, but Camila will enable an extra evaluation route and a dedicated model variant for the fraud use case (keeps traffic isolated). Minimal config changes on your side - just an extra API route and a label mapping.
- Timeline impact: we can keep kickoff on Jun 15 and the baseline run on Jun 22-Jun 28, but we'll add a 3-day buffer for the fraud evaluation (final rebaseline by Jul 5). If that buffer doesn't work, we can shorten baseline to 4 days but will note the reduced statistical power in results.

Action items revised:
- Acme: send eval set + fraud labels (250 samples preferred) by Jun 14, confirm route names for evaluation by Jun 15.
- Redwood: Camila to update POC plan and metrics template; Marissa to update contract addendum (if needed) and timelines.

We'll prepare an updated POC plan and share by EOD Jun 14. Camila - can you confirm the extra route setup and whether we need a separate model variant or can use runtime model routing?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Updated POC plan + rebaseline (attachments)

Hi Alex / Priya - attaching an updated POC plan and metrics template that reflect the added fraud-flagging use case. Highlights:

- New section: Fraud-flagging evaluation (pages 4-6) with suggested precision/recall measurement and sampling guidelines.
- Config: we recommend a dedicated route "/acme/fraud" with model routing to a higher-precision variant for the fraud checks. This keeps latency SLAs for support triage unaffected.
- Data reqs: 250 labeled fraud samples preferred; if you can only provide 50-100 we'll still run a pilot but will flag the result as low-confidence.
- Timeline: Kickoff unchanged (Jun 15). Baseline run Jun 22-Jun 28. Fraud eval window Jun 29-Jul 1. Final rebaseline and recommendations by Jul 5.

Action items (owner + due date):
- Acme: share eval set + fraud labels (Jun 14) - Alex / Priya
- Acme: confirm route names and expected QPS per route (Jun 15) - Alex
- Redwood: provision /acme/fraud route and model variant (Jun 16) - Camila
- Redwood: run baseline and produce metrics report (Jul 2) - Camila / David

Attachments: acme_poc_proposal_v2.pdf, metrics_template.xlsx

If that works, I'll kick off the infra tasks tomorrow and lock the calendar invites.

Thanks,
Camila
